purpose: Diagnostic foot-position guide only, not an accepted finished animation.
valid_cues: A blue right/front and red left/back
B blue planted, red swings forward
C blue left/back and red right/front
D red planted, blue swings forward
known_limitations: Foreground/background occlusion does not consistently preserve near/far identity in C/D.
Passing poses lift the knees too high.
final_row_requirements: Restore original tan/brown boots; no diagnostic color in final pet.
Reduce swing height and keep upright trunk.
Generate a complete coherent 8-frame cycle and review ordered foot trajectories and visible occlusion independently.
normalization: Uniform resize of generated guide only; final pet frames are not derived from these pixels.
